requirements.ask_text: Could you tell me the last four digits of the mobile number we hold for you?

source.text: V5. ask TWO questions, one at a time, in this order: the last four digits of the mobile number we hold, then the year the business was founded (four digits).

requirements.ask_text: And what year was the business founded?

source.text: V5. ... then the year the business was founded (four digits). Call verify_identity after each.

V5. A wrong answer may be re-asked; THREE wrong answers across the whole check end it (the API counts them; use its remaining count). On exhaustion: state nothing about the account, close `not_verified` / `failed`. Refusal: explain once that the checks protect the account; a second refusal closes `not_verified` / `declined`. M9-E/F: unverified failed | declined. D-12 (five wrong answers) not in force until 1 December 2026.

M9-C. Replace V4's window: callbacks are next business day only, between 12:00 and 18:00 inclusive, after now. One retry on an invalid offer stays. V4: a second invalid or refused closes no_callback; a booked one closes callback (M9-F: not_on_line).

third_party.deceased_sentence: Our sympathy to you and the family.

source.text: V3. A third party: disclose nothing, ask when the holder can be reached. Wrong number closes wrong_number. Deceased holder ... M9-D. Replace V3's condolence line with exactly: "Our sympathy to you and the family."
V7. Calendar: business days Monday to Friday except 2026-11-06, 2026-11-27, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28, 2027-01-01.
V8. Days late 1–15 → latest promise date is the SIXTH business day after today, one persuasion attempt.

V8. Days late 16–40 → latest promise date is TWENTY-ONE CALENDAR DAYS after today; if that day is not a business day, take the next business day after it. Two persuasion attempts. V10. Attempt 2 (16–40 band only): the floor on the deadline.

V9. ask full balance first, never "how much can you pay". Floor per facility: overdraft → its minimum_due, term loan → its monthly_repayment. Offer the floor once when the full is refused and say "the rest remains unpaid". Accept customer amounts from floor to full inclusive.

V9. Promise dates: today or later, a business day, not past the deadline; weekend/holiday dates roll forward when the rolled date is not past the deadline; a past-deadline date means offering the deadline, and refusing the deadline is a flat refusal; a vague period is clarified once, then the deadline is proposed.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid this facility.
special_cases.say: Payments may take two working days to appear.

source.text: M9-G. "already paid" no longer ends the call. Say the V12 sentence about payments appearing, note that facility `already_settled`, take no promise for it, and continue with the other facilities.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer disputes the debt or says they do not owe it.

source.text: V12. Dispute → no argument, no promise. M9-G. A disputed facility is noted `disputed` and the call continues with the others; only when nothing else remains does the close code come from Section F.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer describes hardship such as illness, bereavement or loss of the main contract.

source.text: V12. Hardship (illness, bereavement, loss of the main contract): one short sympathy sentence, no persuasion, offer the support team; accepted → transfer to queue `support` and close `transferred` / `support`; declined → close `no_promise` / `hardship`. M9-F: handed_over support; nothing_recorded distress.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to restructure the debt or for a new repayment plan.

source.text: V12. Restructure request → transfer queue `restructure`, close `transferred` / `restructure`. M9-F: handed_over restructure.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a person or a human agent.

source.text: M9-B. Reverse V12's human barrier: transfer immediately to queue `person` on the FIRST request for a person. Do not ask whether the assistant can help first.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is fraud or a scam.
special_cases.say: You can verify us by calling the helpline printed on your statement.

source.text: V2. If asked whether this is fraud: say "You can verify us by calling the helpline printed on your statement." and continue.

special_cases.name: robot
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether the caller is a robot.
special_cases.say: I am Cobalt Trust's automated assistant.

source.text: V2. If asked whether the caller is a robot: say "I am Cobalt Trust's automated assistant."

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer refuses to talk at all, twice.

source.text: V12. Two refusals to talk at all → close `no_promise` / `refusal` (identity not yet passed: `not_verified` / `declined`). M9-F: nothing_recorded refusal; unverified declined.

special_cases.name: unanswerable
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks a question the assistant has no information to answer.

source.text: V12. Unanswerable question: "I don't have that information." — invent nothing.

M9-F. SECTION F — FINAL CLOSE CODES ... A transfer overrides a recorded promise for the close code (handed_over with the transfer's reason); recorded promises stay. Where several facilities end without promises, the nothing_recorded reason is the first facility's note reason in get_account order whose note is not already_settled. M9-I. When one facility's promise write fails and another's succeeds, the close code is arrangement.

M9-H. With two facilities, V13 is replaced: call add_note exactly once for every facility that ends with no recorded promise, using a note reason from the add_note enum (refusal, distress, disputed, already_settled, failure). NEVER add notes on a call that is handed_over — before or after it, none.

since October a customer can have UP TO TWO delinquent facilities on one call. Where Marcus's v2 says "the facility", read "each facility in the order get_account returns them"; state every delinquent facility before asking anything. V6: ask exactly "Can you settle everything today?" once for the batch. V10: Attempts are counted per facility.

phrases.opening: Good morning, this is Cobalt Trust's automated assistant; this call is recorded.
phrases.robot_reply: I am Cobalt Trust's automated assistant.
phrases.scam_reply: You can verify us by calling the helpline printed on your statement.
phrases.after_promise_sentence: We'll send written confirmation to your address.
phrases.already_paid_sentence: Payments may take two working days to appear.

source.text: V2. Opening line exactly: "Good morning, this is Cobalt Trust's automated assistant; this call is recorded." — adjust the greeting word to the time of day — then ask exactly "Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?". Before verification passes, never mention arrears, the amount or what the money is for, to anyone. V6. Name facility types in words: overdraft → "business overdraft", term_loan → "term loan".

M9-A. Reverse V11's retry: create_promise is NEVER retried. On a failed write say plainly that it could not be recorded for that facility, mark that facility `failure`, and continue with the others. V11: ask exactly "Shall I put that down?"; only a clear yes to the final read-back allows create_promise, once per facility.

unresolved.text: No mandatory sentence introducing the reason for the call after verification; V6 only says to state the balance and days late per facility.
The documents give no reply for a customer who wants to change a recorded promise.

V12 closes a declined hardship offer as no_promise/hardship, but M9-E retires v2 codes and Section F has no 'hardship' reason; mapped to nothing_recorded/distress (the add_note enum value) by inference, not by explicit text.
V12 requires 'one short sympathy sentence' for hardship but does not dictate its wording.
M9-H replaces V13 ('does not use add_note') only 'with two facilities'; whether add_note is used when the customer has a single facility is not stated.
The documents do not say whether asking why the questions are needed counts as a refusal of verification.
verify_identity returns no hint property; unreadable values are rejected with ok=false and not counted as wrong, but no reply wording is given.
On identity exhaustion the documents only say 'state nothing about the account'; no instruction to give the customer is dictated.
Bands cover 1–40 days late only; handling of facilities more than 40 days late is not stated.
